graham.brief:
This one won't make the highlight package, and the numbers mostly agree with the shrug. New England carries the 8th-heaviest injury load in the league. That's where I'd start.

New England sends extra rushers more than almost anybody, and Jacksonville has handled that better than most. Shared reads are comfortable, which is exactly when I check the individual numbers.

According to New England Patriots, cornerback Carlton Davis set to return. Trevor Lawrence is the starter who's played 94% of the snaps. Lawrence's line is 32.5 pass attempts, well above the 26 he's averaging.

The books are cooking from the same recipe here. Jacksonville is favored by 2.5 with a 45.5 total. Neither the profiles nor the price finds an edge in this one. Maye's line has come down since it opened, which tends to mean the books expect a lead to protect. Watch whether the number moves again before kickoff, and which way it goes.
